question: Why are inner attendants dearer to a king than outer attendants in this comparison?
premises: A king has inner and outer attendants.
Inner attendants may be dear to the king.
Outer attendants are not dear in the same way.
inference: Closeness and inner access make attendants more favored than those who remain outside.
plain_english: Just as a king's inner attendants are dear to him, but the outer attendants are not.
